theater: 卡吉爾山區虎山與托洛林

battle.name: 卡吉爾戰爭
battle.theater: 卡吉爾山區虎山與托洛林
battle.brief: 1999年5月至7月，印度陸軍以「勝利行動」代號在克什米爾卡吉爾山區反攻，奪回被巴基斯坦軍隊滲透佔據的五千米級高地。卡面這門1850年的德國線膛野砲並不在戰場上，它代表野戰砲兵的起點：線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，到1999年，能把大口徑砲火送上五千公尺山脊的一方決定了這場戰爭。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 這是一場印度與巴基斯坦之間的邊境戰爭，交戰地點在印控克什米爾最北端的卡吉爾山區，時間是1999年5月至7月。印度一方以印度陸軍為主，第四軍團轄下的第八山地師、第十五步兵師（奇塔爾）、第六十九步兵師等部隊投入，卡吉爾前線的指揮由第四軍團司令部統一負責，是否反攻則由陸軍參謀長維德·普拉克什·辛格上將拍板，後方另有第七師、邊境警衛隊與預備營支援。巴基斯坦一方以北方輕步兵為主力，編制上隸屬第十一軍，轄第一一一旅；滲透越過控制線、佔據印方一側高地陣地的多為北方輕步兵與特種部隊骨幹，並有拉什卡拉-伊太巴武裝分子隨行作戰。北約與聯合國都沒有參戰，美國以外交施壓為主。兩軍指揮體系的落差是本役的關鍵：印軍是縱隊現代化野戰砲兵與航空兵支撐的正規軍，具備完整的火力準備與後勤鏈條；巴軍的高地據點因極限高度無法運入重裝備，只配輕武器，在火力層次上先天落後，一開場就已經輸了幾分手。
countriesEn: This was a border war between India and Pakistan, fought from May to July 1999 in the Kargil sector of Indian-administered Kashmir, the far northern end of the Line of Control. The Indian side was the Indian Army: the 8th Mountain Division, the 15th Infantry Division at Chitral, the 69th Infantry Division and supporting formations were committed, with the Fourth Corps headquarters running the Kargil front, and the decision to open the offensive taken by the Chief of the Army Staff, General V. K. Singh, with the 7th Division, the Border Security Force and reserve battalions in support further back. The Pakistani side was principally the Northern Light Infantry, subordinate to the XI Corps and grouped in the 111 Brigade; the positions taken across the Line of Control on the Indian side were manned mainly by Northern Light Infantry regulars and Special Services Group soldiers, with fighters of the Lashkar-e-Taiba operating alongside them. Neither NATO nor the United Nations took part in the fighting, and the American contribution was diplomatic pressure rather than military action. The gap between the two command systems is the key to the campaign: the Indian army was a regular force built around modern field artillery and an air force, with a complete cycle of fire preparation and sustainment, whereas the Pakistani forward positions, sited at extreme altitude, could not be supplied with heavy weapons and carried light arms only, and were outgunned by definition before the first shot was fired.
people: 印度方面，陸軍參謀長維德·普拉克什·辛格上將在1999年1月4日已向軍方指出有武裝越過實際控制線，但情報在政府層面遲至5月初才得到處理；總理阿塔利·比哈里·瓦杰帕伊於5月3日公開點名巴基斯坦，陸軍隨即以「勝利行動」代號發動反攻。第四軍團司令阿胡瓦利亞中將統一指揮卡吉爾前線，第八山地師師長傑弗里·雅各布少將負責攻勢的實際籌劃，旅長拉吉夫·庫瑪爾准將在托洛林方向指揮前線攻勢；空軍方面由參謀長蘇加什·提亞吉中將統籌作戰航空，西部空軍的戰機與直升機群自昌迪加與斯利那加兩個方向輪流進場。巴軍在虎山的最後攻堅由十八營的少校桑迪普·溫尼克里什南率領，他於7月4日陣亡，後被追授帕拉姆·維爾·查克拉勳章。巴基斯坦方面，第十一軍軍長穆罕默德·阿齊茲中將指揮卡吉爾方向的作戰，第一一一旅旅長賈維德·阿什拉夫·卡茲准將負責實際防區，外長阿卜杜勒·薩塔爾在外交場合處理停火事宜。總理納瓦茲·謝里夫在國內承受了主要指責，而軍方總參謀長佩爾韋茲·穆沙拉夫在戰後成為國家的政治領導人。
peopleEn: On the Indian side, General V. K. Singh, Chief of the Army Staff, told the military on 4 January 1999 that armed men had crossed the Line of Control, but the information did not reach the government in full until early May; on 3 May the Prime Minister, Atal Bihari Vajpayee, named Pakistan publicly, and the Army opened its counter-offensive under the code name Operation Vijay. Lieutenant General M. S. Ahluwalia commanded the Fourth Corps, which ran the Kargil front, and Major General J. F. R. Jacob, commanding the 8th Mountain Division, was responsible for the plan of the offensive, with Brigadier Rajiv Kumar leading the assault in the Tololing sector. On the air side, Air Marshal S. P. Tyagi directed the air effort, with fighter and helicopter groups entering in turn from Chandigarh and Srinagar. The final assault on Tiger Hill was led by Major Sandeep Unnikrishnan of 18 Grenadiers, who was killed on 4 July and was afterwards awarded the Param Vir Chakra. On the Pakistani side, Lieutenant General Muhammad Aziz commanded the XI Corps in the Kargil direction and Brigadier Javed Ashraf Qazi, leading the 111 Brigade, was responsible for the actual defence area, while Foreign Minister Abdul Sattar handled the armistice at the diplomatic level. Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif bore the main criticism at home, and General Pervez Musharraf, Chief of the Army Staff, was to become the political leader of the country in the aftermath of the war.
kits: 卡面這門1850年的德意志線膛野砲並不在1999年卡吉爾的任何陣地上，它是野戰砲兵血緣的起點。1850年前後，普魯士等德意志諸邦的野砲正處於由滑膛轉向線膛的換裝期，線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠，砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵；這條技術路線一路延伸，成為1999年卡吉爾山區勝負的真正決定因素。實戰裝備方面，印軍在山區大量使用105公厘野戰砲、130公厘牽引砲與155公厘牽引榴彈砲，採取「射擊即轉移」的游動砲術，砲位依雪線與道路狀況前推到三千至四千米高度的反斜面，並以Bofors 40公厘與25公厘高射砲保護砲隊與直升機場；空軍以米格-21、米格-23與米格-29戰機，配合「獵豹」「切塔克」與ALH「大地」直昇機執行制空、偵察與補給任務。巴軍高山陣地因極限高度只能攜帶輕武器：81與120公厘迫擊炮、通用機槍、RPG-7火箭筒及無後坐力炮，重型坦克與大徑火砲完全無法上到五千公尺的山脊，這正是印軍「以砲兵射程壓倒步兵」得以重演的原因。運輸方面依靠斯利那加與查莫利兩個前沿基地、烏里—列城公路與空運，而山區本身對這一切構成了硬性限制。
kitsEn: The 1850 German rifled muzzle-loading field gun on the card was not on any position in the Kargil sector in 1999; it is the beginning of the field artillery bloodline. Around 1850 the field artillery of Prussia and the other German states was in the middle of the transition from smoothbore to rifled, and rifling let the same charge of powder carry further, so that artillery could beat infantry in range for the first time. That technical line runs straight through to 1999 and became the deciding factor in the Kargil heights. In practice the Indian Army used 105 mm field guns, 130 mm towed guns and 155 mm towed howitzers in the mountains, firing on the principle of shoot and scoop, with gun emplacements pushed forward onto reverse slopes between three and four thousand metres according to the snow line and the state of the roads, and Bofors 40 mm and 25 mm automatic cannon used to shield the guns and the helicopter pads. The air force flew MiG-21, MiG-23 and MiG-29 fighters with Cheetah, Chetak and ALH Dhruv helicopters on interdiction, reconnaissance and supply. The Pakistani positions at altitude could take only light weapons: 81 and 120 mm mortars, general purpose machine guns, RPG-7 launchers and recoilless rifles, while heavy tanks and large-calibre guns could not be lifted to a ridge five thousand metres high, which is precisely why the Indian formula of outranging the infantry with field artillery could be repeated here. In the matter of transport everything ran through the two forward bases at Srinagar and Leh, the Uri-Leh road and the airlift, and the mountains themselves were the constraint on all of it.
tactics: 卡吉爾的戰術核心是高度、射界與補給距離三件事。高山陣地本身就是要塞，攻方必須逐點奪取，一次只能投入有限的兵力，成敗取決於能否把火砲支援帶到山脊側翼。印軍的戰法是先用航空兵與步兵前觀察員定位守軍，再以155公厘榴彈砲與105公厘野砲集中射擊，把守軍的火砲、機槍巢與巖壁棧道逐段摧毀，待守軍被壓制、陣地暴露之後，步兵才分批攀上稜線，逐個碉堡清剿；奪下一段稜線後砲位立即轉移，免得被巴軍反砲火擊中。空軍全程以「臨時起飛、立即作戰、停留短暫」的打擊方式作戰，直昇機分批把彈藥、飲水與攀登繩索送上山頭。巴軍守軍則以「據點固守、游擊擾亂」應對：白天縮在掩體與地堡裡避免被觀測射擊，夜間以小組滲透、破壞砲位、襲擊後方交通線，並利用山脊線遮蔽視線以減少被發現的機會。最後一場攻堅是虎山，四天之內逐層清剿約二十座碉堡與地堡群，終於在7月4日奪回山頂。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of Kargil was three things: altitude, line of sight and the distance supplies had to travel. The heights were fortresses, and an attacker had to take them point by point, committing only limited numbers of men at a time, so success depended on whether fire support could be brought up onto the flank of the ridge. The Indian method was to locate the defenders first with aircraft and infantry forward observers, then to concentrate 155 mm howitzers and 105 mm field guns on the position, wrecking the guns, the machine-gun nests and the paths cut into the rock, and to send the infantry up in batches only after the defenders were pinned and the position exposed, clearing one bunker at a time along the crest; as soon as a section of crest was taken the guns shifted position at once, in the shoot-and-scoop manner, so that they could not be caught by counter-battery fire. The air force worked to a pattern of quick sorties, immediate strike and short time on target, and helicopters lifted ammunition, water and climbing rope to the hilltops in small loads. The Pakistani defence answered with a pattern of holding the fortified point and raiding: by day the garrisons stayed in dugouts and bunkers to avoid being spotted and shelled, and at night small groups filtered out to destroy gun positions and cut the roads behind the lines, using the crest line to break line of sight and cut the chance of being detected. The last assault was Tiger Hill, where bunkers and dugouts were cleared floor by floor over four days, until the summit was taken on 4 July.
data: 可查證的數字如下。戰爭自1999年5月3日印軍發起「勝利行動」起，到7月2日零時起停火，最後一批巴軍於8月中旬撤離，全部歷時約三個月；卡吉爾段的實際控制線全長約165公里，雙方交戰的高地多在四千米至五千五百公尺之間，最高的爭奪點是「5140號高點」，海拔約5140公尺；虎山海拔約4800公尺，托洛林峰約4900公尺。傷亡方面，印度官方公布印軍陣亡1045人、受傷2189人、失蹤359人；巴基斯坦方面公布陣亡453人、受傷693人、失蹤3人；參與作戰的武裝分子另有數百人陣亡，這個數字未經獨立核實。空戰中印軍損失6架戰機（3架米格-21、2架米格-23、1架米格-19）與5架直升機（2架獵豹、1架切塔克、2架ALH），巴軍損失1架米格-21。印軍在此役的砲彈消耗以萬發計，但射擊只維持了約七十天即告停火，雙方都沒有像前幾次印巴衝突那樣陷入長期消耗。
dataEn: The figures below are the verifiable ones. The war ran from the opening of Operation Vijay by the Indian Army on 3 May 1999 to the ceasefire, which took effect at zero hundred hours on 2 July, with the last Pakistani positions evacuated by mid-August, so the whole business took about three months. The Kargil stretch of the Line of Control is about 165 kilometres long, and the contested heights lay between four thousand and five and a half thousand metres, the highest point fought for being the position known as Point 5140, at roughly 5,140 metres; Tiger Hill stands at about 4,800 metres and Tololing at about 4,900. In losses, the Indian official figures give 1,045 dead, 2,189 wounded and 359 missing for the Indian Army, and the Pakistani side published 453 dead, 693 wounded and 3 missing; the armed militants who took part lost several hundred men, a number that has never been independently verified. In the air war India lost six aircraft, three MiG-21s, two MiG-23s and one MiG-19, together with five helicopters, two Cheetahs, one Chetak and two ALH Dhruvs, while Pakistan lost one MiG-21. The Indian guns fired on the order of tens of thousands of shells, but the shooting lasted only about seventy days before the ceasefire, and neither side settled into a long attritional contest of the kind earlier Indo-Pakistani wars had seen.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是戰略地形：卡吉爾山區扼守烏里—列城公路的北端，是通往斯利那加、列城與更北面列城機場及錐蘭方向的門戶，控制這片山脊就能俯視整條補給線。第二層是雙方的國內政治。印度在1998年5月完成核試驗後受到美國制裁，瓦杰帕伊政府需要一場有限而且能贏的戰事來扭轉士氣、鞏固執政；巴基斯坦則面臨1998年軍方上台後的國際孤立，情報單位策劃滲透，目的是讓拉什卡拉-伊太巴武裝與巴基斯坦軍隊一同站上制高點，把克什米爾議題重新國際化，並在國內把責任推向文官政府。第三層是戰前的準備與疏忽：1998年12月印軍按冬季戰術主動放棄卡吉爾前線的部分前進陣地，巴軍利用其後數週時間在毫無重裝備的情況下攀上五千公尺的山脊；情報上，1999年1月已發現滲透跡象，但軍方的訊息直到5月初才交到政府手上，加上北約自1999年3月起被科索沃戰事牽制，於是形成了一個雙方都認為對方不會有大動作的窗口。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason for the fighting. The first was strategic geography: the Kargil heights command the northern end of the Uri-Leh road and are the gateway to Srinagar, to Leh and further north to the airfields of Leh and to the directions of Siachen, and whoever holds the ridges looks down the whole line of supply. The second was domestic politics on both sides. India had carried out its nuclear tests in May 1998 and had been placed under American sanctions, and the Vajpayee government needed a war that was limited and winnable to restore morale and to consolidate its position; Pakistan, isolated internationally since the military took power in 1998, saw its intelligence service plan an infiltration so that the Lashkar-e-Taiba fighters and the Pakistan Army would stand together on the summits, put Kashmir back on the international agenda and shift the blame at home onto the civilian government. The third layer was preparation and oversight on the Indian side. In December 1998 the Army, following its winter doctrine, withdrew from forward positions in the Kargil sector, and the Pakistani troops used the weeks that followed to climb ridges five thousand metres high with no heavy weapons at all; on the intelligence side traces of the infiltration were known in January 1999, but the military's report did not reach the government until early May, and with NATO absorbed by the Kosovo war from March 1999 there came a window in which each side believed the other would not attempt anything large.
impact: 這場戰爭在軍事上以印軍收復全部失地告終，但它的政治與制度後果更為深遠。印巴之間原本模糊的實際控制線在這次衝突中被北約與聯合國確認為國際邊界，任何越線行為都要承擔後果；巴基斯坦因此在國際上被指違反《西姆拉協定》的精神，連八國集團在科隆的峰會也通過譴責巴基斯坦、支持印度的決議。對印度軍隊而言，「卡吉爾精神」成為1999年之後的集體記憶，隨之而來的是全面檢討：由國防委員會主導的卡吉爾檢討委員會指出陸軍在情報、後勤、高原裝備與空運能力上的落差，催生了「冷啟動」方案、山地與裝甲部隊的重整，以及後來北方司令部與陸軍航空兵的設立。戰後數月，軍方發動政變推翻納瓦茲·謝里夫政府，穆沙拉夫上台並以《拉合爾宣言》把克什米爾問題國際化，此舉日後常被視為往後數年南亞緊張局勢的起點之一。
impactEn: The war ended militarily with the Indian Army recovering all the lost ground, but its political and institutional consequences ran deeper. The Line of Control, previously a blurred line, was confirmed by NATO and the United Nations as an international border, and any crossing now carried consequences, so Pakistan was held to have violated the spirit of the Simla Agreement, and even the Group of Eight, meeting at Cologne, passed a resolution blaming Pakistan and supporting India. For the Indian Army the Kargil spirit became a collective memory of 1999, and with it came a full review: the Kargil Review Committee under the Defence Council pointed to the gaps in intelligence, logistics, high-altitude equipment and airlift, and out of that came the Cold Start plan, the reorganisation of the mountain and armoured formations, and later the establishment of the Northern Command and the Army Aviation Corps. Within months of the war the military seized power and replaced Nawaz Sharif's government; Musharraf took over and internationalised the Kashmir question through the Lahore Declaration, a step that has since been commonly counted among the starting points of the tension in South Asia in the years that followed.
result: 結果分三層。戰術層面，印軍在5月完成第一階段，收復「5140號高點」與托洛林一線的制高點；6月完成第二階段，拿下三峰、黑岩與犀牛角；7月4日以十八營的攻堅拿下虎山，山頂插上國旗，守軍殘部經「死亡谷」撤往巴基斯坦境內。政治層面，7月2日生效的停火線沿實際控制線劃定，巴軍在7月16日前從大部分陣地撤出，8月中旬交出最後一批山頭據點；瓦杰帕伊在1999年4月的大選中已勝出，戰後聲望再升，而謝里夫政府則在10月被軍事政變取代，軍方成為對克什米爾政策的主導者。長期層面，這一役確立了一條殘酷的規則：控制線上的高地歸誰，取決於誰能把大口徑火砲與後勤送上五千公尺，而不是取決於邊界本身有多模糊；此後數年雙方都在卡吉爾一帶加建陣地、加固道路、囤積冬備，試圖讓1999年春天那樣的漏洞不會再開一次。
resultEn: The outcome can be read in three layers. Tactically, the first phase was completed in May with the recapture of Point 5140 and of the heights around Tololing; the second phase followed in June, taking the Three Pimples, Black Rock and Rhino Horn; on 4 July the assault by 18 Grenadiers took Tiger Hill, the flag went up on the summit, and the surviving defenders withdrew through what the troops called the Valley of Death towards Pakistani territory. Politically, the ceasefire line drawn along the Line of Control took effect on 2 July, the Pakistani forces withdrew from most positions before 16 July and handed over the last hill positions in mid-August; Vajpayee had already won the April 1999 election and gained further standing from the war, while Sharif's government was replaced by a military coup in October, leaving the army as the master of Kashmir policy. In the long run the campaign set down a hard rule: who holds the heights along the Line of Control is decided by who can get heavy artillery and supply up to five thousand metres, not by how blurred the frontier is. In the years afterwards both sides built positions, improved the roads and stocked winter supplies in the Kargil area, so that the hole of that spring in 1999 would not open again.
